QuestInfo.name: Wonny the Watchman 1
QuestInfo.0: Go see #b#p2152018##k in disguise as a Black Wings member and get some information.
QuestInfo.1: #p2152018#'s job is to make sure everything in town is running smoothly. He doesn't seem to like the job at all, but he might have information. He wants to get #bOfficer #p2152003##k to eliminate some of the #o1150001# population.

0.0: Never seen you around before. Guess the Black Wings are pulling in recruits by the dozens. If you're gonna be one of us, you should get to work.
0.1: Go tell #bOfficer #p2152003##k to take care of those signs. They're acting weird. It isn't much of a job, but it needs to be done... according to the officials upstairs, at least.

yes.0: Just go see #p2152003#. I don't want to talk about the Black Wings right now.

1.0: Hello there, citizen! I'm not on duty at the moment. You have instructions from #p2152018#? So you're one of the Black Wings...

yes.0: I remember when this used to be our city.

npc.0: I thought I told you to talk to #p2152003#. The Police Station is on the #bwestern side of the town#k.
